release_name: Search Title Punctuation and Accent Fallbacks
highlights: Automatic bounded alternate spellings for episode and season-pack provider searches
Apostrophes, hyphens, periods, ampersands and common accents handled without renaming shows
Saved aliases retained; broader results checked against show and episode numbering
Retries stop on acceptable results or provider errors; earlier results retained and duplicates removed
Show Detail and classic Shows display the spelling that found the release

validation.clean_install_routes: Existing isolated Flask route suite passes, including metadata folder and reviewed force-download recovery
validation.browser: Both show screens find the punctuation-free release using the third spelling while preserving the original Wonka title; matched spelling visible and no console errors
validation.live_downloads: Not performed; synthetic indexer and downloader fixtures only
validation.windows_executable: No v18.10.1 executable or Inno installer build claimed

activation: Update source on the server, restart normally and refresh browser pages. Production and 192.168.1.16 were not restarted or deployed to.
